text_block_list.text:
One afternoon— As I was preparing for <chrname>'s 
training...
(Knock knock knock)
Excuse me. Are you Trainer <username>?

Pardon me for not introducing myself 
sooner. I am a reporter for "Monthly 
Twinkle"—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: "My name is Etsuko Otonashi."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I've come today to conduct an interview, 
following an introduction from Chairwoman 
Akikawa.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I shall endeavor not to get in the way of 
your training, so I look forward to 
working with you.

I hadn't heard anything about an 
interview, but their polite and sincere 
demeanor put me at ease.
choice_data_list:
Likewise, I look forward to working with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Please do cooperate with our 
interview.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now then, getting straight to it... The 
racing world has seen immense excitement 
with the launch of the URA Finals, and so 
on—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Could you tell us about your future 
outlook with your trainee Umamusume?"

There have certainly been big 
developments—but my conviction hasn't 
wavered since the day I decided to walk 
alongside <chrname>.
choice_data_list:
I will keep supporting her so she can 
seize her dream.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...I see. In other words, your role as a 
Trainer is—
choice_data_list:
It's to help the Umamusume achieve their 
dreams!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It is wonderful!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
'To help the Umamusume in my charge seize 
their dreams!' 'To assist in doing so!' 
That is what you said, is it not!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it means accepting 
everything if it's to grasp that dream!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
If she asks to train, I'll join her 
anytime; for post-race recovery, we'll 
tour famous hot springs; and if she says 
she's thirsty, I'll climb a mountain to 
fetch water!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san, your resolve... is 
so... so truly admirable...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Looks like the press coverage 
has already begun!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"How's that! This Trainer is quite the 
exceptional talent, wouldn't you say?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Even though it was our first 
meeting, I was so moved that I lost my 
composure...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I hear you are prepared to dive even into 
a storm if it is for the sake of an 
Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Splendid!! Exactly what I'd expect! 
Spoken like a true Trainer of a future 
star Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I've been keeping a close eye on your 
recent performances too!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However... hm-mm-mm! It seems gaining fans 
is proving quite difficult.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Inspiration! There is still time before 
the URA Finals! Stage your comeback from 
here!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you receiving plenty of cheers 
yourself? Indeed, putting on a great 
performance is what truly captures 
people's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
High hopes! I trust you will treat each 
race with utmost care and turn them into 
magnificent results!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astounding!! You received far more cheers 
than I could have ever imagined!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"An Umamusume who captivates people's 
hearts to this extent. Running in the URA 
Finals is no mere pipe dream!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The volume of cheering is the barometer of 
a star Umamusume. It's proof of just how 
much they are loved.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I would like to offer my support as well, 
so that we may gather even more backing.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Appreciation! The media's cooperation is 
essential both for boosting the popularity 
of Umamusume and for ensuring the 
tournament's success!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you, Otonashi-kun!! For 
the success of the URA Finals!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Trainer, I'm counting on you 
as well.

In an effort to drum up support for <chrname>, 
we've managed to connect with a powerful 
ally in more ways than one...
